from collections import Counter, deque
def solve(ti):
    H=len(ti);W=len(ti[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in ti for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def clear_run(i,j,dx,dy):
        n=0
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+dx*ny;j_ := 0
            ni+=dx; nj+=dy
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W) or ti[ni][nj]!=bg: return n
            n+=1
    def ext_len(bar, dx, dy):
        # bar cells along axis
        cells=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if (ti[i][j]==3 and (dx or dy))) 
        return 0
    # identify bars
    b3=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==3]
    b2=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==2]
    horiz3 = len({i for i,_ in b3})==1
    vert3 = len({j for _,j in b3})==1
    horiz2 = len({i for i,_ in b2})==1
    vert2 = len({j for _,j in b2})==1
    assert horiz3==horiz2 or vert3==vert2, 'axis mismatch'
    axis = 'h' if horiz3 else 'v'
    if axis=='h':
        dirs=['L','R']
        def runs(d):
            if d=='L':
                r3=max(j for _,j in b3)-min(j for _,j in b3)+1  # placeholder
                return None
        # clear run length for each bar in each direction along its row
        def bar_run(bar,d):
            row=bar[0][0]
            if d=='L':
                j=min(j for _,j in bar)
                n=0
                while j>0 and ti[row][j-1]==bg: n+=1; j-=1
                return n,j-1
            else:
                j=max(j for _,j in bar)
                n=0
                while j<W-1 and ti[row][j+1]==bg: n+=1; j+=1
                return n,j+n
        r3_l,r3_r=bar_run(b3,'L'),bar_run(b3,'R')
        r2_l,r2_r=bar_run(b2,'L'),bar_run(b2,'R')
        score=lambda dl,dr: (dl+dr)
        # choose direction maximizing total clear space
        best_dir='L' if (r3_l[0]+r2_l[0])>=(r3_r[0]+r2_r[0]) and (r3_l[0]+r2_l[0])>=max(r3_r[0]+r2_r[0], abs(r3_l[0]-r2_l[0])+abs(r3_r[0]-r2_r[0])) else 'R'
        best_dir='L' if (r3_l[0]+r2_l[0])>=(r3_r[0]+r2_r[0]) else 'R'
        def stop_condition(bar_pos,end_col):
            # stop when partner end column reached or blocked
            return False
        # compute each bar's final column: extend until blocked or until partner's final column
        if best_dir=='L':
            fc3=min(j for _,j in b3); fc2=min(j for _,j in b2)
            # simulate mutual growth: each extends until blocked or partner column met
            e3=min(fc3, min(j for i,j in [(a,b) for a in b3 for b in []])) 
            # simpler: extend until blocked; then trim to partner's column if further
            e3L=r3_l[1]; e2L=r2_l[1]
            final3=min(e3L, fc2)  # can't cross partner's end
            final2=min(e2L, fc3)
            paint3=[(r3, j) for j in range(final3, min(fc3, W))] if False else [(r3, j) for j in range(final3, fc3)]
            paint2=[(r2, j) for j in range(final2, fc2)]
            conn_col=final3
            conn=[(i, conn_col) for i in range(min(r3,r2)+1, max(r3,r2))]
        else:
            fc3=max(j for _,j in b3); fc2=max(j for _,j in b2)
            e3R,r3r=bar_run(b3,'R'); e2R,r2r=bar_run(b2,'R')
            final3=max(e3R, fc2) if False else min(e3R+fc3, None)
            # extend until blocked or partner column: partner end is at fc2 (right end) -> extend to max(e3R, fc2)? crossing allowed? use min(max ext, partner col) mirrored
            final3=max(e3R, fc2) if e3R<fc2 else e3R+fc3
            final2=max(e2R, fc3) if e2R<fc3 else e2R+fc3
            paint3=[(r3, j) for j in range(fc3+1, final3)]
            paint2=[(r2, j) for j in range(fc2+1, final2)]
            conn_col=final3
            conn=[(i, conn_col) for i in range(min(r3,r2)+1, max(r3,r2))]

from collections import Counter, deque
def bfs_path(ti):
    H=len(ti);W=len(ti[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in ti for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    starts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==3]
    goals=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==2]
    obs=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j] not in (bg,2,3))
    best=None
    for s0 in starts:
        d={s0}; dq=deque([s0]); par={s0:s0}
        while dq:
            r,c=dq.popleft()
            for nr,nc in ((r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)):
                if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in d and (nr,nc) not in obs:
                    d.add((nr,nc)); par[(nr,nc)]=(r,c); dq.append((nr,nc))
        costs=[]
        for g in goals:
            if g not in d: continue
            L=0; cur=g
            while True:
                p=par[cur]
                if p==cur or p in starts: break
                L+=1; cur=p
            costs.append((L,g))
        if costs:
            _,tgt=min(costs,key=lambda x:x[0])
            painted=[]; cur=tgt
            while True:
                p=par[cur]
                if p==cur or p in starts: break
                painted.append(cur); cur=p
            if best is None or len(painted)<best[0]:
                best=(len(painted),painted)
    return best

from collections import Counter, deque
def solve(ti):
    H=len(ti);W=len(ti[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in ti for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    S=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==3]
    E=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==2]
    seen=set(S)|set(E); dist={p:0 for p in S}; par={}
    dq=deque(S)
    best=None; target=None
    while dq:
        cur=dq.popleft()
        r,c=cur
        for nr,nc in ((r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)):
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in seen and ti[nr][nc]==bg:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); dist[(nr,nc)]=dist[cur]+1; par[(nr,nc)]=cur; dq.append((nr,nc))
    enddists=[dist.get(e) for e in E]
    if not enddists or max(enddists)<min(dist.values()): return [r[:] for r in ti]
    bestd=min(enddists); tgt=E[enddists.index(bestd)] if False else min(E,key=lambda e:dist.get(e,999))
    p=tgt; path=[]
    while dist.get(p,999)>0:
        q=par.get(p)
        if q is None or q in set(S): break
        path.append(p); p=q
    out=[r[:] for r in ti]
    for i,j in path: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def solve(ti):
    H=len(ti);W=len(ti[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in ti for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    b2=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==2]
    b3=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==3]
    out=[r[:] for r in ti]
    # orientation: horizontal if same row
    hor2=all(i==b2[0][0] for i,j in b2); hor3=all(i==b3[0][0] for i,j in b3)
    if hor2 and hor3:  # horizontal bars: slide along row
        r2=b2[0][0]; r3=b3[0][0]
        c2lo,c2hi=min(j for i,j in b2),max(j for i,j in b2)
        c3lo,c3hi=min(j for i,j in b3),max(j for i,j in b3)
        # candidate: each bar slides toward other along its row until obstacle/end; connector vertical between
        best=None
        for d2 in (-1,1):
            for d3 in (-1,1):
                # max slide distance: stop before leaving grid or hitting non-bg in that row
                def maxslide(row,d):
                    n=0; ok=True

steps.input:
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    ti=G[k+' input']; ex=G[k+' output']
    H=len(ti);W=len(ti[0])
    bg=Counter(c for r in ti for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    b2=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==2]
    b3=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==3]
    chg=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ex[i][j]!=ti[i][j])
    print('==',k,'bg',bg,'2:',b2,'3:',b3)
    print('  painted rows/cols:', sorted(set(i for i,j in chg)), sorted(set(j for i,j in chg)))
    # obstacle counts near path
    obs=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j] not in (bg,2,3)]
    print('  obstacles:',obs)

    src=set(b3)+set(b2); tgt=set(b2); S=tgt

    prev={}; q=deque()
    start=min(b3)

from collections import Counter, deque
def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in I for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    b2=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    b3=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    def ok(p,q): return 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and I[p][q] in (bg,)
    tgt=min(b2,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in b3))
    dr=(tgt[0]>min(p[0] for p in b3))-(tgt[0]<max(p[0] for p in b3)); dc=(tgt[1]>min(p[1] for p in b3))-(tgt[1]<max(p[1] for p in b3))
    cur=set(b3); paint=set(); tset=set(tgt)
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    while True:
        blockedV=any(not ok((p[0]+dr,p[1])) or (p[0]+dr,tg[1]) in tset for tg in [tgt] for p in []) or any(not ok((p[0]+dr,p[1])) or (p[0]+dr,tgt[1]) in tset for p in cur)
        # simpler: check collision including target cells
        blockedV=any(not ok((p[0]+dr,p[1])) or (p[0]+dr,tgt[1]) in tset for p in cur)
        blockedH=any(not ok((p[0],p[1]+dc)) or (tgt[0],p[1]+dc) in tset for p in cur)
        if blockedV and blockedH: break
        if not blockedV: cur={(p[0]+dr,p[1]) for p in cur}
        else: cur={(p[0],p[1]+dc) for p in cur}
        for p in cur:
            if p not in set(b3): paint.add(p)
        if all(abs(p[0]-tgt[0])<=1 and abs(p[1]-tgt[1])<=1 for p in cur): break
    for p in paint: O[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    return O
for n in range(1,6):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    F=f(I); print(n, F==O)

    def ok(p,q): return 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and I[p][q]==bg
    tgt=min(b2,key=lambda t:min(abs(t[0]-q[0])+abs(t[1]-q[1]) for q in b3))

def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in I for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    b2=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    b3=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    def ok(p,q): return 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and I[p][q]==bg
    tgt=min(b2,key=lambda t:min(abs(t[0]-q)+abs(t[1]-q) for q in b3))
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in b3),max(p[0] for p in b3)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in b3),max(p[1] for p in b3)
    dr=1 if (r0+r1)/2<tgt[0] else -1
    dc=1 if (c0+c1)/2<tgt[1] else -1
    cur=set(b3); paint=set(); O=[r[:] for r in I]; adj_t={(a,b) for a,b in b2}
    while True:
        blockedV=any(not ok((p[0]+dr,p[1])) or (p[0]+dr,tgt[1]) in adj_t for p in cur)
        blockedH=any(not ok((p[0],p[1]+dc)) or (tgt[0],p[1]+dc) in adj_t for p in cur)
        if blockedV and blockedH: break
        if not blockedV: cur={(p[0]+dr,p[1]) for p in cur}
        elif not blockedH: cur={(p[0],p[1]+dc) for p in cur}
        else: break
        for p in cur:
            if p not in set(b3): paint.add(p)
        if min(abs(p[0]-tgt[0]),abs(p[1]-tgt[1]) for p in cur)<=1: break
    for p in paint: O[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    return O

from collections import deque, Counter
def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in I for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    s=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    g=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    tgt=min(g, key=lambda t:min(abs(t[0]-q[0])+abs(t[1]-q[1]) for q in s))
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    cur=set(s); paint=set()
    while True:
        blockedV=any(not ok(p[0]+dr,p[1],O) or O[p[0]+dr][tgt[1]]!=bg and O[p[0]+dr][tgt[1]]!=3 for p in cur)
        # blocked check against target bar cells specifically
        blockedV=any(not (0<=p[0]+dr<H and 0<=p[1]<W and O[p[0]+dr][p[1]]==bg)
                     or any(O[a][b]==2 and abs(a-(p[0]+dr))==1 and b==p[1] for a,b in g) for p in cur)
        blockedH=any(not (0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]+dc<W and O[p[0]][p[1]+dc]==bg)
                     or any(O[a][b]==2 and a==p[0] and abs(b-(p[1]+dc))==1 for a,b in g) for p in cur)
        if blockedV and blockedH: break
        if not blockedV:
            nxt={(p[0]+dr,p[1]) for p in cur}
        else:
            nxt={(p[0],p[1]+dc) for p in cur}
        cur=nxt
        for p in cur:
            if p not in set(s): paint.add(p)
        if all(min(abs(p[0]-t[0]),abs(p[1]-t[1])) for p in cur for t in [tgt])<=1: break
    for p in paint: O[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    return O
def ok(a,b,Og): return 0<=a<len(Og) and 0<=b<len(Og[0]) and Og[a][b]==bg

from collections import Counter
def parse(I,O):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in I for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    s=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    g=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    return bg,s,g
def paintset(I,O):
    return {(i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]}
for n in range(1,7):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg,s,g=parse(I,O)
    P=paintset(I,O)
    print(n,'painted:',sorted(P))

from collections import Counter,deque
def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(c for r in I for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    S=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    Gc=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    gset=set(Gc)
    # 3 bar: is it horizontal or vertical? find contiguous run
    horiz = len({i for i,j in S})==1 and len(S)>1
    vert  = len({j for i,j in S})==1 and len(S)>1
    out=[[I[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    return bg,S,Gc,horiz,vert,out
for n in range(1,7):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg,S,Gc,horiz,vert,_=f(I)
    paint=sorted(set((i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]))
    print(n,'h' if horiz else ('v' if vert else '?'),len(S),'goal',Gc,'paint:',paint[:60])

from collections import Counter,deque
import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in range(1,7):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in I for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    S=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3)
    Gc=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2)
    paint=sorted(set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]))
    # bar orientation
    rs={i for i,j in S}; cs={j for i,j in S}
    orient = 'h' if len(rs)==1 else ('v' if len(cs)==1 else '?')
    print(f'--- demo {n}: bar orient {orient}, cells {S}; goal {Gc}')
    for r_ in range(H):
        line=''
        for j in range(W):
            v=I[r_][j]
            if (r_,j) in set(S): line+= 'B'
            elif (r_,j) in set(Gc): line+= 'G'
            elif (r_,j) in set(paint): line+= 'P'
            else: line+= '.' if v==bg else str(v)
        print(f'{r_:2d} {line}')
